meta.title: Our SME cybersecurity method | Smidjan Wallonia
meta.description: Measured diagnosis, risk-based prioritisation, real remediation, continuous monitoring: discover Smidjan's method, a cybersecurity firm in Wallonia, and why a Walloon SME benefits from working with a human-scale structure.
meta.ogDescription: Proof, not promises: measured diagnosis, prioritisation, real remediation and continuous monitoring. The Smidjan method, cybersecurity for SMEs in Wallonia.
meta.twitterDescription: Measured diagnosis, prioritisation, real remediation, continuous monitoring. Proof, not promises.

hero.title: Cybersecurity that <accent>proves itself</accent>, not one that tells stories.
hero.lead: For SMEs in Wallonia: measured actions, deliverables you verify yourself. Our method, from assessment to follow-up.
hero.promiseSub: What you get, on every engagement
hero.promiseItem1: A quantified and documented diagnosis, not an impression.
hero.promiseItem2: Clear priorities by risk and by SME budget.
hero.promiseItem3: Real remediation: we fix what we find.
hero.promiseItem4: Verifiable proof of the before and after, without jargon.

philosophy.title: <accent>Proof</accent>, not promises
philosophy.lead: Too many providers sell a feeling of security. I give you the means to verify it yourself: measured diagnosis, actionable deliverables, proven result.
philosophy.quote: "Don't take my word for it: the starting gap, the fixes applied, the measured result." My rule, on every engagement.
philosophy.badItem2: A 200-page report that ends up in a drawer.
philosophy.badItem4: Jargon that hides the lack of results.
philosophy.goodItem1: A starting score, measured and explained.
philosophy.goodItem2: A prioritised plan, readable by a non-technical director.
philosophy.goodItem4: A before and after comparison you can verify.
philosophy.proofAriaLabel: Illustration of an audit report: a list of findings ticked off one by one, validated by a verification seal.
philosophy.proofCaption: Every finding, ticked and verified: the proof, not the talk.

method.title: Four <accent>steps</accent>, from the first finding to lasting follow-up
method.lead: Audit, security testing, NIS2 / CyFun compliance: the same method every time. You know what is happening and what you receive.

diagnostic.title: Diagnosis
diagnostic.text: We measure your real exposure: infrastructure, networks, applications. A quantified state of play, not an opinion.
diagnostic.d1: Clear report, with a starting score.
diagnostic.d2: Mapping of your assets and risks.
diagnostic.d3: Gap analysis against the target level.

priorisation.title: Prioritisation
priorisation.text: We rank the vulnerabilities by risk and by effort, a roadmap designed for an SME budget. You decide, with full knowledge of the facts.
priorisation.d1: Plan prioritised by risk and cost.

remediation.title: Remediation
remediation.text: Our difference: we don't just list the vulnerabilities, we fix them. Hardening, MFA, backups, segmentation: every action applied, then re-tested.
remediation.d2: Re-test that proves the effect of each action.
remediation.d3: Before and after comparison of the score.

supervision.title: Monitoring & follow-up
supervision.text: Security is not a one-off project. We watch, we adjust, we stay alert, with a single point of contact, directly reachable.

ai.title: AI works with me. It does <accentOnDark>not decide</accentOnDark> in my place.
ai.lead: AI helps me monitor more broadly and sort faster. The analysis and the decision remain human, yours and mine.
ai.honest: In full transparency: AI is a support tool, not a product we sell you. It never replaces the expertise or your validation.

veille.title: Accelerated watch
veille.text: We anticipate the threats that genuinely concern you.

detection.title: Broader detection
detection.text: More signals analysed, the anomaly spotted earlier.

mailles.title: Nothing slips through the cracks
mailles.text: A second, automated look at configurations and fixes.

decision.title: Human decision
decision.text: Every AI finding validated by the expert before any action.

why.title: The rigour of a firm, the closeness of a <accent>partner</accent>
why.lead: A human-scale structure, by choice. Fewer intermediaries, more accountability.
why.photoAlt: Close-up of a printed circuit board, illustrating a secure-by-design architecture.
why.photoCaption: A dedicated expert, directly reachable, never a call centre or a junior.

local.title: Local & responsive
local.text: Based in Wallonia, we intervene quickly. Your data stays in Belgium / the EU.

acces.title: Direct access to the expert
acces.text: You speak to the person handling your case. Never a call centre, never a junior.

pragmatisme.title: SME pragmatism
pragmatisme.text: We fix what matters for your budget. Every euro targets a real, explained risk.

partenaire.title: A single partner
partenaire.text: Build, secure, comply: everything in one place. No more providers passing the buck.
partenaire.pin: One point of contact, end to end

refs.title: A methodology aligned with the <accent>reference</accent> frameworks
refs.lead: Our audits and compliance work rely on recognised frameworks, for comparable and defensible results.
refs.honestyText: These frameworks are my working method. Official CyFun certification is issued by BELAC-accredited bodies, not by me. My role: to audit, to fix, to bring you ready for submission.

owasp.title: Testing & application security
owasp.text: Web audits and security tests following the OWASP methodology, the industry criteria.

iso.title: Security management
iso.text: Governance and risk management aligned with ISO/IEC 27001, a coherent, documented posture.

cyfun.title: Belgian & European compliance
cyfun.text: Compliance work aligned with the CCB's CyberFundamentals and the NIS2 directive, the official Belgian framework.

cta.title: Let's take stock, no commitment
cta.text: 30 minutes with an expert. You leave with a first quantified finding and clear priorities. A free first exchange, no commitment.
